# ONLYOFFICE DocSpace: API Reference

> Integrate ONLYOFFICE DocSpace into your application to interact with its REST API using GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/llms.txt).

## Get started

- [Introducing ONLYOFFICE DocSpace](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/basic-concepts.md): ONLYOFFICE DocSpace is a collaborative cloud platform that allows users to edit and collaborate on documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and forms in customizable rooms. It provides the following features:
- [Get ONLYOFFICE DocSpace](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/get-onlyoffice-docspace.md): ONLYOFFICE offers these ways to access and use DocSpace:
- [Authentication](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication.md): Interacting with the DocSpace API requires authentication. ONLYOFFICE offers several methods to authenticate your requests. The chosen authentication method depends on your application's purpose, its users, and the features it requires.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2.md): The OAuth 2.0 authorization protocol enables a third-party application to obtain limited access to an HTTP service.
- [Creating OAuth app](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/creating-oauth-app.md): To create a new OAuth application, send a POST request to the api/2.0/clients address.
- [Editing OAuth app](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/editing-oauth-app.md): For security purposes, DocSpace allows you to edit only the App name, App icon, Description, and Authentication method settings. Future versions of DocSpace might expand this list to include other settings.
- [Using the Auth button](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/auth-button.md): With your OAuth app configured, you can now embed the Auth button on your website to let users sign in with DocSpace.
- [Developer token](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/developer-token.md): You can generate a developer access token that allows you to make API calls without authorization. To obtain access tokens for other users, apply the standard OAuth flow.
- [Authorization flow](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/authorization-flow.md): When a user clicks the authorization link, any of these four scenarios can occur:
- [Viewing active authorizations](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/viewing-active-authorizations.md): Each user can see the applications they have granted access to on the profile page, on the Authorized apps tab.
- [OpenID Connect](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/openid-connect.md): OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an authentication protocol based on OAuth 2.0, which simplifies the way to verify the identity of users and obtain basic profile information in a secure and standardized way. It is commonly used in scenarios where applications need to authenticate users and establish their identity.
- [API keys](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/api-keys.md): API keys are simple tokens used to authenticate API requests. They act as a unique identifier and secret that confirms the identity of the calling application or service.
- [Personal access tokens](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/personal-access-tokens.md): Follow these steps to generate a PAT and use it to authorize your DocSpace account:
- [Basic authentication](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/basic-authentication.md): The basic authentication is defined in RFC 7617 and transmits credentials as a username and password pair, encoded using Base64. The credentials are included in the Authorization header in the following format:
- [Long-running operations](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/long-running-operations.md): The user initiates a long-running operation by sending a request to the appropriate API endpoint, which returns an object containing information about the initiated operation. An example of such a request and response:
- [Uploading large files](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/uploading-large-files.md): In this article, you will learn how to upload large files to DocSpace using our API Backend.
- [Webhooks](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/webhooks.md): Webhooks are HTTP/HTTPS callbacks triggered by events (triggers) related to portal entities such as Users, Groups, Documents, Folders, and Rooms. DocSpace users can create, subscribe to, and configure webhooks so that events in the portal trigger actions in external services. This functionality is useful for synchronizing and tracking specific events.
- [Removed users](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/removed-users.md): Users removed from the DocSpace portal are specified with the LostUser constant, which is a UserInfo object in the following format:
- [SDKs](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks.md): ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDKs for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [C](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/csharp-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for C# is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [Java](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/java-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Java is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [PHP](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/php-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for PHP is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [Postman](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/postman-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Postman is a simple Postman Collection for integrating with the ONLYOFFICE DocSpace API.
- [Python](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/python-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Python is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [TypeScript](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/typescript-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for TypeScript is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.

The engine never invokes user-supplied middleware or callbacks directly — every observable side-effect is encoded as a ChatEvent so the same stream can be replayed over SSE, WebSocket, or in-process. Pause point - message-start / message-delta / message-end — assistant reply lifecycle. - message-incomplete — the provider returned an error or incomplete status. - thread-title — auto-generated title ready for a new thread.

- [Auto-creating home room](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/auto-create-home-room.md): Create a personal home room for every new user via webhooks.
- [Auto home folder](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/auto-home-folder.md): Create a personal home folder for each new user in a shared room.

- [Copying uploads to internal room](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/copy-uploads-to-internal.md): Copy newly uploaded files from a client room to an internal room.
- [Creating client room](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/create-client-room.md): Onboard a client by creating a room with templates and restricted access.

- [Detecting confidential docs](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/detect-confidential-docs.md): Find documents marked as confidential and move them to a secure room.
- [Disabling inactive contractors](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/disable-inactive-contractors.md): Disable external contractors who have not logged in recently.
- [Finding abandoned rooms](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/find-abandoned-rooms.md): Identify rooms that have not been updated within a given time period.

- [Moving task docs on close](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/samples/advanced-samples/move-task-docs-on-close.md): Move task documents to a Completed folder when the task is closed.
